# robots.txt — HSR Utility (https://hsrutility.com)
#
# Policy: this is a public marketing site. Everything on it exists to be found.
# There is nothing to protect, so the default is "allow", and the AI crawlers that
# send traffic/citations back to us are named explicitly rather than left to the
# wildcard group.
#
# Note on precedence: a crawler obeys the MOST SPECIFIC group matching its own
# user-agent, and ignores `*` entirely once it finds one. So each bot named below
# must restate its own Allow/Disallow — that is not redundancy, it is required.

# ── Everything else (Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, …) ──
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# NB: a `Content-Signal:` line (Cloudflare's opt-in AI-usage extension) was tried here
# and removed. It is not part of RFC 9309, so validators — including Lighthouse — report
# it as an unknown directive and fail the robots.txt audit. Google's parser would simply
# ignore it, so it costs a clean SEO score to buy a signal almost nothing reads. If this
# site ever moves behind Cloudflare, reconsider.

# ── AI answer engines — these cite sources and drive referral traffic. ALLOW. ──

# OpenAI (ChatGPT). OAI-SearchBot builds the search index that produces citations;
# ChatGPT-User fetches on demand when a user asks about a URL. GPTBot is the
# training crawler — allowed here for brand recall in future models.
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

# Anthropic (Claude). Split into three distinct bots as of Feb 2026.
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-User
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

# Perplexity — heaviest citer of the lot (~2x ChatGPT's citations per answer).
User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

# Google Gemini / AI Overviews grounding + training.
# NB: this is a directive on Googlebot, not a separate crawler. Disallowing it would
# NOT remove us from Google Search — but we want the AI surfaces, so: allow.
User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

# Apple Intelligence / Siri.
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Allow: /

# Meta AI.
User-agent: meta-externalagent
Allow: /

# Amazon (Alexa/Rufus).
User-agent: Amazonbot
Allow: /

# ── Bulk scrapers with no citation or traffic value back to us. ──
# These feed downstream datasets without attribution. Blocking costs us no
# discoverability — neither surfaces links to this site.
# To trade that for maximum training reach instead, flip both to `Allow: /`.
User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

Sitemap: https://hsrutility.com/sitemap-index.xml
